Looping you both in — Jared shared the endpoints and targets. I ran a quick sanity check on our planned runs and sketched out the recommended fleet mix in the attached interim notes. TL;DR recommendation:

- Baseline (priority): H100 full-GPU for training-like generation paths where TTFT matters (p50/p95 headroom).
- Cost-tier: A100 full-GPU for sustained high-throughput batched workloads (better $/token at scale but watch tail latency).
- Edge/Scale-out: L40S for dev staging and smaller parallelization; use MIG (4-way) on L40S for predictable multi-tenant isolation in early rollout.

Important: for the 2k concurrent bursts Jared mentioned, the plan should include a mixed-cluster stress test where we route short-burst traffic to a pool of L40S (MIG) and reserve H100s for latency-sensitive flows. This reduces risk of p95 tail spikes during peak.

I've attached perf_results_h100_vs_a100.pdf (first-pass run notes) — results show H100 p95 advantage for long-context runs (+~18% lower p95) but A100 marginally better sustained throughput in 32GB configs. MIG saw ~10–25% higher p95 depending on allocation.

Ben — can you confirm capacity availability for a mixed Dedicated pool and estimated monthly commitment delta if we add H100 nodes vs A100-only?

Camila Reyes
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: MAP & Eval — final perf recommendation and close timeline

Jared / Priya — short update and recommended final MAP line items before we lock the contract:

1) Summary of perf findings (from POC runs 2026-06-01 -> 2026-06-06):
   - H100 full-GPU: met TTFT 250ms median and p95 ~820–880ms on /generate-news-summary across 1.2k context; sustained throughput ~120 rps per node with batching.
   - A100 full-GPU: sustained throughput slightly higher (~135 rps) for short-context batched jobs but p95 was ~1.05–1.2s on long-context samples.
   - L40S (4-way MIG): predictable per-slice throughput for multi-tenant dev/staging but p95 penalties on long contexts (~1.3–1.5s).
   - MIG vs full: MIG reduces effective isolation risk but increases p95 by ~10–25% depending on allocation size and KV cache efficacy.

2) Recommended fleet for Production go-live:
   - Primary latency tier: H100 full-GPU nodes (reserve minimum 8 nodes) for /generate-news-summary and other latency-sensitive endpoints.
   - Bulk batch tier: A100 full-GPU nodes dedicated to high-throughput embedding and offline generation jobs.
   - Dev/Canary tier: L40S with 4-way MIG for multi-tenant staging and low-cost scale testing.

3) MAP milestones (finalized):
   - 2026-06-11: Final perf report (drive link) and SLO wording for contract (owner: Camila).
   - 2026-06-15: Legal/Procurement pricing sign-off (owner: Sergio).
   - 2026-06-18: Contract signature & Dedicated capacity reservation (target close).
   - 2026-07-01: Production cutover window (reserve capacity + run canary).

4) Contingency plan: if p95 exceeds 1.1s during rollout, enable automatic fallback to a trimmed-context model variant and scale H100 pool by 20% while we investigate.

Attachments: MAP_v2.xlsx (updated timeline/owners), kpi_checklist.docx (final metric definitions).

Please reply with any redlines to the MAP timeline by EOD 2026-06-11. If we get sign-off, I'll loop in Finance for the reserved commit and Legal for DocuSign.

Thanks all — excited to get this across the line.

Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
